breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses stiffness-based load sharing (F1 = P·k1/(k1+k2) and F2 = P·k2/(k1+k2)) rather than splitting the load equally. This aligns with the ground truth approach where parallel bars share load in proportion to their axial stiffnesses AE/L.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies a single common elongation δ shared by both bars (compatibility condition), and explicitly verifies that δ = F1L/(A1E1) = F2L/(A2E2). It does not add the two elongations together, correctly treating the parallel configuration as having one common displacement.
